events.title: 🌊 Welcome to Atlantis — the tide has opinions
events.description: You found Atlantis. The map is real, the reef outline is lovingly imaginary, and the city council still disputes whether the old capital counts as a venue. Explore the nearby listings, choose a local landmark, and see how KRWL> can make a place feel alive. Want a real community map? Fork the project and configure your own region.

events.title: 🕰️ The Tide Clock Is Only Mostly Right
events.description: The clockmaker insists it is accurate to within one myth. Bring a shell, compare predictions, and help decide whether the next tide is coming in or merely considering it.

events.title: 🧭 Lost & Found for Things the Current Borrowed
events.description: One umbrella, three invitations, and a very confident lobster are looking for their owners. Unclaimed items will be entered into the municipal folklore archive.

events.title: 🎷 Seaweed Jazz: Improvisations in E-flatfish
events.description: A small ensemble plays standards, current events, and one long briny note requested by the kelp. Seating is first come, first gently floated.

events.title: 🍲 Community Soup Exchange (Please Label Your Bubbles)
events.description: Bring a pot, a spoon, and a clear description of what is in it. The anchovy broth won last month, although the judges may have been anchovies.

events.title: 🗿 Archaeology Walk: Please Do Not Adopt the Statues
events.description: A guided stroll through the old plaza, ending at the amphora that may or may not be a mailbox. Comfortable flippers recommended; historical certainty not included.

events.title: 📱 Shellphone Repair Clinic
events.description: Cracked screen? Weak signal? Phone full of sand despite never visiting a beach? Volunteer technicians will take a look. The clinic cannot recover messages sent by dolphin.

events.title: 🧘 Gentle Current Yoga for Beginners
events.description: A slow-flow class for anyone whose balance has been rearranged by the sea. No experience required; the instructor will demonstrate how to stay on the mat while it drifts.

events.title: 🌱 Reef Garden Volunteer Morning
events.description: Help the gardeners rehome coral fragments, untangle a few overenthusiastic vines, and put the sign back up after the octopus borrowed it. Gloves and patience provided.

events.title: 📚 Story Hour: The Fish Who Missed the Bus
events.description: A cozy reading circle for young sea creatures and grown-ups who still enjoy a map with too many arrows. Readers welcome; dramatic bubble effects encouraged.

events.title: 🏮 Bioluminescent Lantern Parade
events.description: Follow the glowing jellyfish along the reef and back to the plaza. Please do not take the lanterns home; they are attached to very small, very determined animals.

events.title: 🏊 The Tiny Triathlon: Swim, Glide, Nap
events.description: Three friendly stages, no stopwatch, and a generous nap break. Sea turtles may enter the glide section but must let everyone else finish first.

events.title: 🛍️ Makers Market: Shells, Maps & Questionable Pottery
events.description: Browse handmade reef crafts, current-proof maps, and a vase that looks better from one side. Vendors accept pearls, barter, and sincere compliments.

events.title: 🏛️ City Council: Is a Reef a Public Park?
events.description: Residents are invited to debate signage, public seating, and whether a crab can be fined for moving the boundary markers. The meeting will end when everyone agrees, or when the tide does.

events.title: 🎤 Open Mic Night: Sea Shanties & Soft Complaints
events.description: Share a song, a poem, or a polite complaint about the municipal current. The house band knows three chords and one of them is a bubble.

events.title: 🐚 Family Shell Hunt (Please Return the Shells)
events.description: A gentle scavenger hunt for colorful shells and clues. Every shell goes back where it came from; the prize is a certificate and the satisfaction of excellent noticing.

events.title: 🐬 Public Forum: Are Dolphins Actually Listening?
events.description: A lively, evidence-based discussion. Dolphins may attend but have not confirmed whether they will take questions or simply make that sound again.

events.title: 🗺️ Lost City Walking Tour — No Promises About the Walking
events.description: Explore the old avenues, point out the former bakery, and learn why every street seems to lead to the same fountain. Flippers optional; a sense of direction is aspirational.

note: A fictional Atlantis neighborhood showcase: events use relative times and nearby fictional venues to demonstrate KRWL> filters, markers, categories, and location presets.
